name: Tomistoma
sum: The false gharial of Southeast Asia, a narrow-snouted fish-eater now placed with the gharials, and perhaps two fossil species.
wsnote: The genus article gives no measurements.
holotype: Living genus — the name-bearing type of the type species is not covered by the sources used.
material: The living false gharial; fossils referred to the genus from the Paleogene to the Quaternary of Africa, Europe and Asia, most of them probably other genera.
biology: Uses its long, narrow snout to catch fish. Its skeleton resembles true crocodiles, but molecular studies consistently place it with the gharial in Gavialidae.
author: Müller 1846
